resources.string: CheapTrip is a unique search engine that finds the cheapest ways between cities, combining flights, buses, trains and ferries.
Matter Of Choice presents interactive scenarios to help you learn decision-making skills.

On-device AI picks the model that fits: if the one you chose does not fit in free memory right now, the next installed one answers, and the answer says which and why.
Photos are answered on your phone only for now -- they are not sent to cloud models. With no model that can see installed, or none that fits, the app offers one that would fit, with a button that opens it on Models.
Mini-apps: the on-device answer follows your chosen language and settings. Settings → On-device AI turns the mini-app answers on or off.
